name: Advanced Building Industries Co.
summary: Advanced Building Industries Co. focuses on the creation and production of various engineered products, integrated systems, and associated services. The company organizes its activities into distinct divisions: Air Conditioner Industry, Steel Industry, Insulation Industry, and Corporate Office and Others. Its offerings encompass a wide range of items, including prefabricated steel buildings, general steel structures, and sophisticated air conditioning and climate control systems tailored for commercial, industrial, and residential applications. Additionally, it provides telecom and transmission towers, specialized process equipment, precast concrete construction components, and a selection of insulation materials like fiberglass, rock wool, and engineered plastic foam, alongside undertaking solar power projects. The firm was established on July 8, 1998, and is headquartered in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.
